POST /v1/analytics/events.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.event_date AS bucket, e.platform AS g1, countIf(e.event = 'bond_deal') AS deals, uniqExactIf(e.one_id, e.event = 'bond_deal') AS deal_users, uniqExact(e.one_id) AS _k FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event IN ('bond_deal') GROUP BY bucket, g1) SELECT bucket, g1, deals, deal_users, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT base.bucket, base.g1, if(base._k < 20, NULL, base.deals) AS deals, if(base._k < 20, NULL, base.deal_users) AS deal_users, base._k AS _k FROM base) ORDER BY bucket, g1
warnings: plan L0 because agg not in MV

POST /v1/analytics/funnel.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.one_id, windowFunnel(604800)(toDateTime(e.time), (e.event = 'hq_stockdetail_view'), (e.event = 'bond_order'), (e.event = 'bond_deal')) AS level FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event IN ('bond_deal', 'bond_order', 'hq_stockdetail_view') GROUP BY e.one_id HAVING level > 0) SELECT step, if(_k < 20, NULL, users) AS users, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT step, uniqExactIf(one_id, level >= step) AS users, uniqExactIf(one_id, level >= step) AS _k FROM base ARRAY JOIN range(1, 4) AS step GROUP BY step) ORDER BY step

POST /v1/analytics/retention.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, toMonday(toDate(e.time, 'Asia/Taipei')) AS cohort FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-09-20') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event = 'app_login_success' AND (e.event = 'app_login_success') GROUP BY one_id, cohort), r AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, toMonday(toDate(e.time, 'Asia/Taipei')) AS rb FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-09-20') AND toDate('2026-11-13') AND e.event = 'app_login_success' AND (e.event = 'app_login_success') GROUP BY one_id, rb), u AS (SELECT c.one_id AS one_id, c.cohort AS cohort, groupArrayIf(dateDiff('week', c.cohort, r.rb), r.rb >= c.cohort AND dateDiff('week', c.cohort, r.rb) <= 3) AS periods FROM c LEFT JOIN r ON c.one_id = r.one_id GROUP BY c.one_id, c.cohort) SELECT cohort, period, users, if(users < 20, NULL, retained) AS retained, if(users < 20, NULL, retained / users) AS rate, users < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT cohort, period, uniqExact(one_id) AS users, uniqExactIf(one_id, arrayExists(p -> p >= 1 AND p <= period, periods)) AS retained FROM u ARRAY JOIN range(1, 4) AS period GROUP BY cohort, period) ORDER BY cohort, period

POST /v1/analytics/path.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, e.time AS time, e.event_id AS event_id, e.session_id AS session_id, multiIf(e.event = '$AppEnd', '離開', e.event) AS node, (node = 'app_login_success') AS is_anchor FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16')), p AS (SELECT *, dateDiff('second', lagInFrame(time, 1, time) OVER (PARTITION BY one_id ORDER BY time, event_id), time) > 1800 AS brk FROM ev), sq AS (SELECT one_id, time, event_id, node, is_anchor, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY one_id ORDER BY time, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sid FROM p), s AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arraySlice(arraySort(x -> (x.1, x.4), groupArray((time, node, is_anchor, event_id))), 1, 200) AS seq FROM sq GROUP BY one_id, sid), m AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arrayFilter((x, i) -> i = 1 OR x.2 != seq[i - 1].2, seq, arrayEnumerate(seq)) AS seq2 FROM s), x AS (SELECT one_id, sid, if(seq2[-1].2 = '離開', seq2, arrayPushBack(seq2, (seq2[-1].1, '離開', 0, seq2[-1].4))) AS seq3 FROM m), r AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arrayMap(y -> y.2, sl) AS path, dateDiff('millisecond', sl[1].1, sl[-1].1) AS dur FROM (SELECT one_id, sid, arraySlice(seq3, idx, 4) AS sl FROM x ARRAY JOIN arrayEnumerate(seq3) AS idx WHERE seq3[idx].3)) SELECT path, if(_k < 20, NULL, _k) AS users, if(_k < 20, NULL, _n) AS sessions, if(_k < 20, NULL, _ms) AS avg_ms, anchor_users, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT path, uniqExact(one_id) AS _k, count() AS _n, avg(dur) AS _ms, (SELECT uniqExact(one_id) FROM r) AS anchor_users FROM r GROUP BY path) ORDER BY _k DESC, _n DESC, path LIMIT 100

POST /v1/analytics/attribution.sql: WITH conv AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, e.time AS ct, e.event_id AS cid, ifNull(toFloat64(e.amount), 0) AS v FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event = 'bond_deal' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16')), tp AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, e.time AS tt, multiIf(e.event = '$pageview', 0, e.event = 'hq_stockdetail_view', 1, e.event = 'app_login_success', 2, -1) AS ti, '' AS sp FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-09-24') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event IN ('$pageview', 'app_login_success', 'hq_stockdetail_view') AND ti >= 0), tpu AS (SELECT one_id, groupArray((tt, ti, sp)) AS ts FROM tp GROUP BY one_id), seq AS (SELECT c.one_id AS one_id, c.ct AS ct, c.cid AS cid, c.v AS v, arraySort(x -> x.1, arrayFilter(x -> x.1 < c.ct AND x.1 >= c.ct - toIntervalDay(7), t.ts)) AS touches FROM conv AS c LEFT JOIN tpu AS t ON c.one_id = t.one_id), w AS (SELECT one_id, ct, cid, v, touches, length(touches) AS n, arrayMap(x -> exp2(-(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ct) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(x.1)) / 1000 / 604800.0), touches) AS raw_decay, arrayMap(r -> r / arraySum(raw_decay), raw_decay) AS w_decay, arrayMap(i -> if(n = 1, 1, if(n = 2, 0.5, if(i = 1, 0.4, if(i = n, 0.4, 0.19999999999999996 / (n - 2))))), arrayEnumerate(touches)) AS w_pos, arrayMap(x -> [1.0, 1.0, 1.0][x.2 + 1], touches) AS raw_custom, arrayMap(r -> if(arraySum(raw_custom) = 0, 1 / n, r / arraySum(raw_custom)), raw_custom) AS w_custom FROM seq) SELECT ti, if(_k < 20, NULL, first_conv) AS first_conv, if(_k < 20, NULL, first_val) AS first_val, if(_k < 20, NULL, linear_conv) AS linear_conv, if(_k < 20, NULL, linear_val) AS linear_val, _k, conversions, converters, touched, total_value, avg_touches, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT t.2 AS ti, sum(if(i = 1, 1, 0)) AS first_conv, sum(if(i = 1, 1, 0) * v) AS first_val, sum(1 / n) AS linear_conv, sum(1 / n * v) AS linear_val, uniqExact(one_id) AS _k, (SELECT count() FROM seq) AS conversions, (SELECT uniqExact(one_id) FROM seq) AS converters, (SELECT countIf(n > 0) FROM w) AS touched, (SELECT sum(v) FROM seq) AS total_value, (SELECT avg(n) FROM w WHERE n > 0) AS avg_touches FROM w ARRAY JOIN touches AS t, arrayEnumerate(touches) AS i GROUP BY ti) ORDER BY ti

POST /v1/semantic/compile.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT a.event_date AS bucket, countMergeIf(a.cnt, a.event = 'bond_deal') AS m1, uniqMerge(a.users) AS _k FROM dmp.events_daily_agg AS a WHERE a.project = 'golden' AND a.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND a.event IN ('bond_deal') GROUP BY bucket) SELECT bucket, m1, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT base.bucket, if(base._k < 20, NULL, base.m1) AS m1, base._k AS _k FROM base) ORDER BY bucket

POST /v1/users/estimate.sql: WITH (SELECT groupBitmapState(one_id_uint) FROM dmp.users AS e FINAL WHERE 1 AND (e.`tier` IN ('P1', 'P2'))) AS bm_u, (SELECT groupBitmapState(one_id_uint) FROM (SELECT e.one_id_uint AS one_id_uint FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event = 'bond_deal' GROUP BY e.one_id_uint HAVING count() >= 3)) AS bm_b1, bitmapAnd(bm_u, bm_b1) AS bm SELECT bitmapCardinality(bm) AS users

POST /v1/users/list.sql: WITH (SELECT groupBitmapState(one_id_uint) FROM dmp.users AS e FINAL WHERE 1 AND (e.`tier` IN ('P1', 'P2'))) AS bm_u, (SELECT groupBitmapState(one_id_uint) FROM (SELECT e.one_id_uint AS one_id_uint FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event = 'bond_deal' GROUP BY e.one_id_uint HAVING count() >= 3)) AS bm_b1, bitmapAnd(bm_u, bm_b1) AS bm SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, e.`tier` AS `tier`, e.`lifecycle` AS `lifecycle`, multiIf(e.`aum` IS NULL, NULL, e.`aum` < 0.0, '<0', e.`aum` < 1000000.0, '0–1000000', e.`aum` < 5000000.0, '1000000–5000000', '≥5000000') AS `aum`, multiIf(e.`churn_score` IS NULL, NULL, e.`churn_score` < 0.0, '<0', e.`churn_score` < 40.0, '0–40', e.`churn_score` < 70.0, '40–70', e.`churn_score` < 100.0, '70–100', '≥100') AS `churn_score`, e.`branch_id` AS `branch_id`, e.`last_active_at` AS `last_active_at`, toUInt8(0) AS _s, e.one_id_uint AS _u FROM dmp.users AS e FINAL WHERE bitmapContains(bm, e.one_id_uint) ORDER BY _s ASC, _u ASC LIMIT 50

POST /v1/segments/estimate.sql: WITH (SELECT groupBitmapState(one_id_uint) FROM dmp.users AS e FINAL WHERE 1 AND (e.`tier` IN ('P1', 'P2'))) AS bm_u, (SELECT groupBitmapState(one_id_uint) FROM (SELECT e.one_id_uint AS one_id_uint FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event = 'bond_deal' GROUP BY e.one_id_uint HAVING count() >= 3)) AS bm_b1, bitmapAnd(bm_u, bm_b1) AS bm SELECT bitmapCardinality(bm) AS users

POST /v1/iam/scope/simulate.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.event_date AS bucket, e.platform AS g1, multiIf(sumIf(e.amount, e.event = 'bond_deal' AND e.amount IS NOT NULL) IS NULL, NULL, sumIf(e.amount, e.event = 'bond_deal' AND e.amount IS NOT NULL) < 0.0, '<0', sumIf(e.amount, e.event = 'bond_deal' AND e.amount IS NOT NULL) < 100000.0, '0–100000', sumIf(e.amount, e.event = 'bond_deal' AND e.amount IS NOT NULL) < 500000.0, '100000–500000', sumIf(e.amount, e.event = 'bond_deal' AND e.amount IS NOT NULL) < 1000000.0, '500000–1000000', sumIf(e.amount, e.event = 'bond_deal' AND e.amount IS NOT NULL) < 5000000.0, '1000000–5000000', '≥5000000') AS m1, uniqExactIf(e.one_id, e.event = 'bond_deal') AS m2, uniqExact(e.one_id) AS _k FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'altatech_dmp' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event IN ('bond_deal') GROUP BY bucket, g1) SELECT bucket, g1, m1, m2, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT base.bucket, base.g1, if(base._k < 20, NULL, base.m1) AS m1, if(base._k < 20, NULL, base.m2) AS m2, base._k AS _k FROM base) ORDER BY bucket, g1

POST /v1/dashboards/d_seed_bond/cards/c_.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.one_id, windowFunnel(604800)(toDateTime(e.time), (e.event = 'hq_stockdetail_view'), (e.event = 'bond_order'), (e.event = 'bond_deal')) AS level FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event IN ('bond_deal', 'bond_order', 'hq_stockdetail_view') GROUP BY e.one_id HAVING level > 0) SELECT step, if(_k < 20, NULL, users) AS users, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT step, uniqExactIf(one_id, level >= step) AS users, uniqExactIf(one_id, level >= step) AS _k FROM base ARRAY JOIN range(1, 4) AS step GROUP BY step) ORDER BY step

POST /v1/dashboards/d_seed_bond/cards/c_.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, toMonday(toDate(e.time, 'Asia/Taipei')) AS cohort FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-09-20') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event = 'app_login_success' AND (e.event = 'app_login_success') GROUP BY one_id, cohort), r AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, toMonday(toDate(e.time, 'Asia/Taipei')) AS rb FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-09-20') AND toDate('2026-11-13') AND e.event = 'app_login_success' AND (e.event = 'app_login_success') GROUP BY one_id, rb), u AS (SELECT c.one_id AS one_id, c.cohort AS cohort, groupArrayIf(dateDiff('week', c.cohort, r.rb), r.rb >= c.cohort AND dateDiff('week', c.cohort, r.rb) <= 3) AS periods FROM c LEFT JOIN r ON c.one_id = r.one_id GROUP BY c.one_id, c.cohort) SELECT cohort, period, users, if(users < 20, NULL, retained) AS retained, if(users < 20, NULL, retained / users) AS rate, users < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT cohort, period, uniqExact(one_id) AS users, uniqExactIf(one_id, arrayExists(p -> p >= 1 AND p <= period, periods)) AS retained FROM u ARRAY JOIN range(1, 4) AS period GROUP BY cohort, period) ORDER BY cohort, period

WITH ev AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, e.time AS time, e.event_id AS event_id, e.session_id AS session_id, multiIf(e.event = '$AppEnd', '離開', e.event) AS node, (node = 'app_login_success') AS is_anchor FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16')), p AS (SELECT *, dateDiff('second', lagInFrame(time, 1, time) OVER (PARTITION BY one_id ORDER BY time, event_id), time) > 1800 AS brk FROM ev), sq AS (SELECT one_id, time, event_id, node, is_anchor, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY one_id ORDER BY time, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sid FROM p), s AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arraySlice(arraySort(x -> (x.1, x.4), groupArray((time, node, is_anchor, event_id))), 1, 200) AS seq FROM sq GROUP BY one_id, sid), m AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arrayFilter((x, i) -> i = 1 OR x.2 != seq[i - 1].2, seq, arrayEnumerate(seq)) AS seq2 FROM s), x AS (SELECT one_id, sid, if(seq2[-1].2 = '離開', seq2, arrayPushBack(seq2, (seq2[-1].1, '離開', 0, seq2[-1].4))) AS seq3 FROM m), r AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arrayMap(y -> y.2, sl) AS path, dateDiff('millisecond', sl[1].1, sl[-1].1) AS dur FROM (SELECT one_id, sid, arraySlice(seq3, idx, 4) AS sl FROM x ARRAY JOIN arrayEnumerate(seq3) AS idx WHERE seq3[idx].3)) SELECT path, if(_k < 20, NULL, _k) AS users, if(_k < 20, NULL, _n) AS sessions, if(_k < 20, NULL, _ms) AS avg_ms, anchor_users, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT path, uniqExact(one_id) AS _k, count() AS _n, avg(dur) AS _ms, (SELECT uniqExact(one_id) FROM r) AS anchor_users FROM r GROUP BY path) ORDER BY _k DESC, _n DESC, path LIMIT 100

WITH conv AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, e.time AS ct, e.event_id AS cid, ifNull(toFloat64(e.amount), 0) AS v FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event = 'bond_deal' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16')), tp AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, e.time AS tt, multiIf(e.event = '$pageview', 0, e.event = 'hq_stockdetail_view', 1, e.event = 'app_login_success', 2, -1) AS ti, '' AS sp FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'golden' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-09-24') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event IN ('$pageview', 'app_login_success', 'hq_stockdetail_view') AND ti >= 0), tpu AS (SELECT one_id, groupArray((tt, ti, sp)) AS ts FROM tp GROUP BY one_id), seq AS (SELECT c.one_id AS one_id, c.ct AS ct, c.cid AS cid, c.v AS v, arraySort(x -> x.1, arrayFilter(x -> x.1 < c.ct AND x.1 >= c.ct - toIntervalDay(7), t.ts)) AS touches FROM conv AS c LEFT JOIN tpu AS t ON c.one_id = t.one_id), w AS (SELECT one_id, ct, cid, v, touches, length(touches) AS n, arrayMap(x -> exp2(-(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ct) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(x.1)) / 1000 / 604800.0), touches) AS raw_decay, arrayMap(r -> r / arraySum(raw_decay), raw_decay) AS w_decay, arrayMap(i -> if(n = 1, 1, if(n = 2, 0.5, if(i = 1, 0.4, if(i = n, 0.4, 0.19999999999999996 / (n - 2))))), arrayEnumerate(touches)) AS w_pos, arrayMap(x -> [1.0, 1.0, 1.0][x.2 + 1], touches) AS raw_custom, arrayMap(r -> if(arraySum(raw_custom) = 0, 1 / n, r / arraySum(raw_custom)), raw_custom) AS w_custom FROM seq) SELECT ti, if(_k < 20, NULL, first_conv) AS first_conv, if(_k < 20, NULL, first_val) AS first_val, if(_k < 20, NULL, linear_conv) AS linear_conv, if(_k < 20, NULL, linear_val) AS linear_val, _k, conversions, converters, touched, total_value, avg_touches, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT t.2 AS ti, sum(if(i = 1, 1, 0)) AS first_conv, sum(if(i = 1, 1, 0) * v) AS first_val, sum(1 / n) AS linear_conv, sum(1 / n * v) AS linear_val, uniqExact(one_id) AS _k, (SELECT count() FROM seq) AS conversions, (SELECT uniqExact(one_id) FROM seq) AS converters, (SELECT countIf(n > 0) FROM w) AS touched, (SELECT sum(v) FROM seq) AS total_value, (SELECT avg(n) FROM w WHERE n > 0) AS avg_touches FROM w ARRAY JOIN touches AS t, arrayEnumerate(touches) AS i GROUP BY ti) ORDER BY ti
